name: CODEX — contemporary cloth sewn case binding
format: Deterministic parameterized Three.js model; geometry is generated locally at startup.

dimensions.note: Units describe a display model. Microstructure, crease radii, and thread diameter are enlarged slightly for legibility.

signatures.fold_model: Two continuous leaves meet through a circular, arc-length-controlled Y-axis bend. Front, back, and perimeter form a thin closed solid with analytic normals.
signatures.trimmed_edge_detail: Procedural fine folio-edge relief supplements individual modeled sheet edges once the signatures align.

sewing.supports: Three woven linen tapes transverse to the spine
sewing.route: The continuous path alternates through the fold interior and around each tape, then links to the next gathering at the head or tail. Hole mouths are small dark surface insets; no boolean drill geometry is used.

spine.rounded_by: Subtle signature offsets along a common convex spine profile
spine.lining: Thin following cream lining on a shared dynamic buffer
spine.endbands: Alternating ivory and warm-grey wound thread at both head and tail

case.construction: Separate rounded board cores, cloth skins, four hinged turn-ins per board, cloth edge returns, hollow curved spine cloth, marbled pastedowns, and attached flyleaf
case.marbled_uv: Full original plate from 0 to 1; no recrop, randomized offset, or repeat

physical_typography.method: Canvas mask on native cover UVs changes albedo, metalness, roughness, and a recessed normal gradient in the actual cloth material. Spine type follows the curved spine shell.
physical_typography.gold: Title and subtitle, spine title, one narrow fore-edge and a short corresponding head-edge line. No emission.

chapters.name: FOLD
chapters.state: Continuous centre fold, then four nested sheets

chapters.name: GATHER
chapters.state: Instanced signatures emerge, order, align and compress

chapters.name: SEW
chapters.state: Tape supports and one progressively drawn through-fold thread path

chapters.name: SPINE
chapters.state: Spine lining settles and two endbands are formed

chapters.name: MARBLE
chapters.state: Text block remains behind the separate marbling scene

chapters.name: CASE
chapters.state: Separate boards receive cloth, turn-ins wrap, and the case closes

chapters.name: PRESS / GILD / STAMP
chapters.state: A small die contacts the cover and the physical impression appears

chapters.name: CODEX
chapters.state: Finished book; optional 100-degree hinged opening reveals endpaper

motion_contract.allocations: All meshes, buffers, curves, maps, and reusable matrix helpers are created at startup. Update mutates existing transforms, shader uniforms, draw ranges and typed buffers.
